definition: Suggesting that future events will be successful or fortunate.
book: Gulliver's Travels into Several Remote Nations of the World
author: Jonathan Swift
quote: Signed and sealed on the fourth day of the eighty-ninth moon of your majesty’s auspicious reign.
example_sentence: A sunny morning felt like an auspicious start to the trip.
